CPE (Cost per Engagement) suites support three types of campaigns:

* CPE \- Retention  
* CPE \- Purchase/Payer  
* CPE \- Level Complete

Links

* [Understanding Event Optimaztion Models](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AI_HzvMuilbOz5kynasjk1IJpn7h2MIlZYbxVVh17Vg/edit?usp=sharing)  
* Slack channel: [\#vector-user-value-dev](https://unity.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C06Q5D269DZ),  [\#vector-cpe](https://unity.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C09M1ESSNMT), 

### CPE \- Retention

Share the same model as the UV model; traffic is served by [main\_retention\_d7 head](https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/vector-ai-unity-learner/blob/1836111a41b13ab9a2f0074f9b2b0ecee3594284/src/unity_learner/experiment_repo/unified_user_value/v3_q3a/config.json#L291)

* Production pipeline: [unified-user-value-v3-q3a-10-workflow-scheduled](https://console.cloud.google.com/agent-platform/pipelines/locations/us-central1/schedules/5183187973289541632?project=unity-applied-research-ml-test)  
* Branch: [prd-v3-twr-q3a](https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/vector-ai-unity-learner/tree/prd-v3-twr-q3a)

Data

* Share the same dataset as the UV model  
* Incremental dataset: [unity-ads-dd-ds-prd.user\_value\_incremental\_datagen.uv\_v26\_q2a\_mesh\_v2lf](https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery?project=unity-ads-dd-ds-dev-prd&ws=!1m6!1m5!4m3!1sunity-ads-dd-ds-prd!2suser_value_incremental_datagen!3suv_v26_q2a_mesh_v2lf!23sRESOURCE_LIST)  
* Training label \`post\_install\_retention\_d7\`  
* Query to check label distribution in incremental datagen

```sql
SELECT
  date,
  source,
  Count(date) AS installs,
  AVG(IF(post_install_retention_d7 > 0, 1, 0))  AS retention_rate_d7,
 FROM `unity-ads-dd-ds-prd.user_value_incremental_datagen.uv_v26_q2a_mesh_v2lf`
 WHERE date >= '2026-01-01'
   AND target_game_id = '500237245'
 GROUP BY date, source
 ORDER BY date, source
```

Model

* Model prediction check

```sql
SELECT
  submit_date,
  body.app_event_type,
  CASE body.app_event_type
    WHEN 'level_complete' THEN body.model_versions.level_complete.version
    WHEN 'purchase'       THEN body.model_versions.purchase.version
    WHEN 'retention'      THEN body.model_versions.retention.version
  END AS cpe_model_version,
  MAX(body.target_game_id)  AS target_game_id,
  COUNT(*)                  AS start_count,
  AVG(body.app_event_p)     AS avg_cpe_pred,
  AVG(body.app_event_adj)   AS avg_cpe_adj
FROM `unity-ai-data-prd.mz_dcpi_raw.mz_dcpi_prediction_v1`
WHERE submit_date BETWEEN "{start_date}" AND "{end_date}"
  AND body.ar_ts >= "{start_date} 00:00:00"
  AND body.app_event_type IN ('level_complete', 'purchase', 'retention')
  AND body.app_event_p > 0
  -- AND body.target_game_id IN ({target_game_id})
  -- AND body.campaign_id = "{campaign_id}"
GROUP BY submit_date, body.app_event_type, cpe_model_version
ORDER BY submit_date
```

* Use [this skill](https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/vector-ai-unity-learner/blob/uv-prediction-doc/.claude/skills/uv-prediction-check/uv-prediction-report.md) to generate UV model predictions (including both ROAS and CPE) for target game or campaign IDs across any timeframe. ([Example report](https://github-html-preview.dohyeon5626.com/?https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/vector-ai-unity-learner/blob/uv-prediction-doc/.claude/skills/uv-prediction-check/uv_prediction_report_500023036.html&eyJhbGciOiJkaXIiLCJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0..myh4vzfhKEBt-0Kv.1IGQPWvOKhOXNkDGOcPUjDJby0NxKHhhsRvXYX8sW5BHZ6KMKG4uVXyoHyDql5Q_kU-j-3md9M-6G3SidfWG0ncR77v4I4GSyC7_j3BVU6onpD9Oc20xx075U37ThahSswgAhjJtWHbuMk38osBH4FKXWCpldmPeWfASbuxQlYELh7GoNu1d9Q.yOwXLB1H_Lm2Yjd3qOFLyQ&1784921854916))

Monitoring is similar to [User Value Model Science On-Call SOP](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GTlMIGKidVmWXOUEb5s_6gecjDa0bJjMP1IUEnGz_xM/edit?usp=sharing).

* Use [Imply link](https://internal-v2-1.pivot.int-prd-imply.unity3d.com/pivot/d/a3852db2088cad946e/uAds_Demand_Supply_Internal_\(billing_&_finance\)) to CPE performance (Campaign Type \== \`appEventConversion\`). Sub-CPE (Retention, Payer, Level Complete) breakdown is under \`App Events Campaign\`  
* ![][image1]![][image2]

Blocklisting  
CPE \- Retention and Payer blacklisting share the same blacklisting table with UV model. But with different event\_type in the table

```py
event_type in blacklisting table: traffic name in UV model
"Purchase"                      : "iap", 
"AdRev"                         : "adrev",
"Retention"                     : "retention",
"Payer"                         : "payer",
```

Please follow [this SOP](https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/ads-event-blocklist/blob/master/usage.md) and [these handful sample queries](https://docs.google.com/document/d/10plHDewMOrOS5c4w4THBWesBljsDoDTFA4MZDl12gSA/edit?usp=sharing) to block any game.

### CPE \- Level Complete

* Recurrent pipeline: [user-value-v11-cpe-lc-v2-1-workflow-scheduled-15-utc](https://console.cloud.google.com/agent-platform/pipelines/locations/us-central1/schedules/75050464688734208?project=unity-applied-research-ml-test)  
* Running time: 15 UTC daily  
* Branch: [level\_complete-mogration-v2](https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/vector-ai-unity-learner/pull/4955)

Offline Evaluation for LC model: [v11\_cpe\_lc offline\_eval\_on\_removing\_creative\_level\_features.ipynb](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1hr7y1Svc9xVsJMzibGfpe3Z2Zop-cA8Z?usp=sharing)

Monitoring  
Level Complete model currently has a 3-8% zero valuation rate because of the gating logic that the model only bids on the seen (target\_game\_id, target\_event) level. Any unseen combo will result in zero bidding.   
Details in 2.5 Online Bidding Gate — Eligibility Requirement section in [\[v11\_cpe\_lc\] Design Doc — CPE Level Complete UL Migration](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fgwEWQlMYhCQhhQ2akdIZ9uj43KgAUU4Na4BhOXDch0/edit?usp=sharing)  
**trained\_game\_sdk\_combo.json** example file can be found in: [unity-ads-dd-ds-prd-incremental-training-data/user\_value/unified\_user\_value.v11\_cpe\_lc/trained\_game\_sdk\_combo.json](https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/_details/unity-ads-dd-ds-prd-incremental-training-data/user_value/unified_user_value.v11_cpe_lc_v2/trained_game_sdk_combo.json;tab=live_object?pageState=\(%22StorageObjectListTable%22:\(%22f%22:%22%255B%255D%22\)\)&project=unity-ads-dd-ds-prd) 

Example:

```json
  "500037794_af_level14": 1.0,
  "500037795_af_level11": 1.0,
  "500037795_af_level14": 1.0,
  "500037795_af_level20": 1.0,
  "500037795_af_level30": 1.0,
  "500035432_*": 1.0,  --> Game has either empty or multiple target event in campaign settings

```
